chunks: During the period of the praiseworthy emissaries, there were reliable individuals to whom epistles were returned by those appointed for the deputyship from the source.
ai.seo_question: Who received the Imam's epistles during the period of the Four Deputies?
ai.summary: This passage highlights the rigorous verification process during the Minor Occultation (al-Ghaybah al-Sughra), where trusted companions (thiqat) served as intermediaries to ensure the authenticity of the Imam’s written directives (tawqī'āt) before they reached the broader community. It underscores the Shia scholarly emphasis on the continuity of divine guidance through a structured, hierarchical chain of authority, reinforcing the legitimacy of the Four Deputies (al-Nuwwab al-Arba'ah) as the primary sources of religious law and administrative order.
